subject: Request: Stability window & staggered ingress plan for Solace-7b family
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Claudia Rivera <claudia@solace.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Stability window & staggered ingress plan for Solace-7b family

Hi all,

Solace just delivered the 7B family (solace-7b, solace-7b-quant, solace-7b-legacy-tokenizer). They asked to be onboarded this week for a handful of premium customers. Before we do any traffic ingress I need operations/product/infra alignment on a few specific asks so we don't regress availability or quality for existing routes.

High-level asks:
- Provide a 72-hour "stability window" in staging -> canary -> prod with staggered ingress (3 waves).
- Pin the serving variant to solace-7b@20271101-rc2 for the duration of the window; fallback to solace-7b-quant-v1 if kernel/quant path fails.
- Validate tokenizer normalization differences — Solace shipped a different unicode normalization which causes minor token shifts.
- Confirm quantization path compatibility (NF4 + fused rotary kernels) across our GPU fleet.
- Telemetry: we need token-level latency, oom rate, prefix-KV hit rate, and likelihood drift vs baseline on the eval suite.

Attachments: solace_model_spec.pdf (model manifest), tokenizer-diff.txt (short example of tokenization diffs).

Timeline proposal: start pre-warm + staging tests Tues Nov 9 06:00 UTC; canary wave 1 Wed Nov 10 00:00 UTC; full stagger to follow if green by end of Wed. Need owners and explicit go/no-go windows by EOD tomorrow (Nov 9 PDT).

Questions for owners:
- Marissa: product — acceptable rollout criteria and measure of quality regressions we’ll allow?
- David: infra — resource/slot requirements + suggested pin duration and routing policy.
- Karthik: compatibility/safety — any known blockers for quantization or tokenizer changes?
- Laura: staging/CI — what test matrix do you need to clear to green the canary?

Claudia: looping you in so Solace engineers can respond to tokenization/quant questions quickly.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. PM, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claudia Rivera <claudia@solace.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 11:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Stability window & staggered ingress plan for Solace-7b family

Thanks Irene — this looks actionable. A few product clarifications and a proposed acceptance checklist: 

Acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Perplexity/QA benchmarks: no >3% drop on our core prompts and no >5% drop on privacy-sensitive prompts.
- Latency SLO: p95 should remain within +25ms of current baseline for similar seq lengths during wave 1.
- No regression in hallucination category on the 500-prompt eval set (we’ll run focused reranking checks).

Rollout plan idea (3 waves):
1) Staging smoke (internal only) — run full eval + stress (24h).
2) Canary wave (5% traffic from premium customers in eu-west only) — monitor 72h.
3) Gradual ramp (25% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h) if metrics stable.

If any of the three metrics (perplexity, latency, hallucination) fails during the first 72h, we rollback to the pinned fallback variant and open an incident.

I attached a short canary-runbook.md with required dashboards and alert thresholds. Note that for premium customers we can offer opt-in early access in eu-west but we should require explicit customer acknowledgement.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Group PM, Generative Product
[Attachment: canary-runbook.md]

From: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claudia Rivera <claudia@solace.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Stability window & staggered ingress plan for Solace-7b family

Quick infra readout:
- Resource footprint: solace-7b (fp16) requires 44GB of GPU RAM with a large KV cache when seq len >2k. solace-7b-quant (NF4) drops mem by ~30% but needs fused-kernel paths we only have tested on Ampere+ and Hopper.
- Pre-warm: recommend 48h pre-warm of a small pool (2 nodes per region) to populate KV caches.
- Pin proposal: pin to solace-7b@20271101-rc2 for the 14-day stabilization period; fallback variant should be solace-7b-quant-v1 pinned in routing for immediate failover.
- Routing policy: route by customer-tier + latency budget; eu-west premium routes first; region fallback to us-west only if both solace variants fail in eu.

Ops constraints: TF serving kernels show rare divergence on some fused rotary codepaths (we saw a 0.2% token-level mismatch on long sequences). We need a fast compatibility shim we can hotfix in runtime if we encounter numpy/torch-cuda kernel mismatch. If that happens, fallback to solace-7b-quant-v1 automatically.

I’ll prepare a short infra-change PR with the pin and routing policy; need a sign-off from product and safety before merging.

-David
David Kim
Director, Platform Engineering

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claudia Rivera <claudia@solace.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Stability window & staggered ingress plan for Solace-7b family

Safety/compatibility notes:
- Tokenizer differences: solace-7b-legacy-tokenizer does NFC vs NFKC normalization in a few emoji sequences which changes tokenization. We need a compatibility layer or canonicalization in the tokenization pipeline — otherwise downstream evals will be noisy.
- Quantization: NF4 is supported in our runtime but we have not validated the combined NF4 + fused-rotary kernels across all driver versions. I request a hard block on shipping any NF4-based variant to >10% traffic until validation passes.
- Licensing: Solace included a binary weight blob under an evaluation license; legal must confirm redistribution and retention policy before Private deploys (VPC/on-prem). Laura, can you help surface the legal tag for review?

Proposed immediate mitigations:
1) Add a thin tokenizer-normalize step in the tokenizer wrapper (owner: Laura) to align NFC behavior for canary.
2) Allow NF4 quant path only in staging + canary wave 1 (5% traffic) and require explicit signoff to open NF4 to ramp.
3) Pin a stable non-quant fallback (solace-7b@20271101-rc2) and set automatic rollback on drift alerts.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Model Safety & Compatibility

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Claudia Rivera <claudia@solace.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Stability window & staggered ingress plan for Solace-7b family — consolidated plan

Thanks for the quick turn. Consolidating and assigning next steps so we can get Solace moving without creating churn for other routes.

Consolidated plan (agreed unless I hear objections by EOD PDT Nov 10):
- Pin: solace-7b@20271101-rc2 will be pinned in routing for 14 days starting the moment we merge the infra PR. Fallback: solace-7b-quant-v1 (auto-failover). (Owner: David)
- Tokenizer normalization shim (NFC canonicalization) to be added for canary runs; Laura to land in staging by Nov 9 18:00 UTC. (Owner: Laura)
- NF4 quant path: allowed only in staging + canary wave 1 (5% traffic). Hard block on opening NF4 beyond 10% without explicit Karthik signoff. (Owner: Karthik + David)
- Pre-warm: 48h pre-warm pool in eu-west (2 nodes). (Owner: David)
- Metrics & thresholds: Marissa will publish exact dashboards and alert thresholds by EOD Nov 9. If any threshold trips during the 72h stability window, we rollback to the pinned fallback. (Owner: Marissa)
- Legal review: Laura to circulate license notes for on-prem/redistribution risk and confirm any additional constraints by Nov 11.

Customer-facing note: Claudia — Solace, we can support an opt-in early access in eu-west for premium customers but it must be explicitly acknowledged and will be limited to 5% traffic for 72h.

Next steps for me: I will open the infra PR to pin the variant and create the canary alert dashboard; will set an automated rollback hook tied to the hallucination/perf alerts.

If anyone needs to change owners/dates, please reply inline. Otherwise I'll treat this as approved and begin infra work.

Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. PM, Model Onboarding
Redwood Inference
[Attachments referenced above: solace_model_spec.pdf, tokenizer-diff.txt, canary-runbook.md]
